name: Test pack
note: A complete example with made-up data: profiles, lines, needs, shifts, runs, hour checks, racks, partial racks, the needs board, trace and production report, two terminal groups, four responsibility centers with an escalation ladder, six test people, and two media-library instructions. Install on a test folder.

def.label: Runs of the last 400 days (for the report)
The latest run on a line
A run by its ID (a year back)
A shift by its ID (a year back)
Hour checks of a run (a year back)
Racks made on a run (a year back)
Hour checks of the last 31 days
A color code in words
def.formula: IF(code = "W", "White", IF(code = "AL", "Almond", IF(code = "BLK", "Black", IF(code = "DS", "Desert Sand", IF(code = "BRZ", "Bronze", IF(code = "MS", "Mix sell", code))))))

def.label: Racks of a need made on other lines, in words
def.formula: IF(COALESCE(n, 0) > 0, " · " & n & " made on other lines", "")

def.label: Open needs of a line, first first
def.formula: SORT(FILTER(NeedsAll(), AND(item.line = line, item.$open)), item.priority & "|" & item.$firstAt)

def.label: Needs being run now on other lines
def.formula: EACH(FILTER(RunsRecent(), AND(item.$status = "Running", NOT(ISBLANK(item.need)), item.line <> position)), item.need)

def.label: Needs a line can run: its own, then other lines' not running
def.formula: SORT(FILTER(NeedsAll(), AND(item.$open, OR(item.line = line, item.$id = IF(ISBLANK(LastRunOn(position).need), "", LastRunOn(position).need), AND(NOT(IN(item.$id, NeedsRunningElsewhere(position))), NOT(IN(item.$id, COALESCE(taken, LIST()))))))), IF(item.line = line, "0", "1") & "|" & item.line & "|" & item.priority & "|" & item.$firstAt)

def.label: The need a line runs next
def.formula: IF(ISBLANK(LastRunOn(position).need), FIRST(OpenNeedsFor(line)).$id, IF(IN(LastRunOn(position).need, EACH(OpenNeedsFor(line), item.$id)), LastRunOn(position).need, FIRST(OpenNeedsFor(line)).$id))

def.label: Hours a run can still be checked for
def.formula: FILTER(LIST(DATEADD(STARTOF(NOW(), "hour"), -1, "hours"), STARTOF(NOW(), "hour")), AND(item >= STARTOF(startAt, "hour"), OR(ISBLANK(endAt), item < endAt), NOT(IN(item, COALESCE(done, LIST())))))

def.label: How a run stands on hour checks
def.formula: IF(COUNT(FILTER(SlotsOpen(startAt, done, endAt), item < STARTOF(NOW(), "hour"))) > 0, "late", IF(COUNT(SlotsOpen(startAt, done, endAt)) > 0, "due", "done"))

def.label: Hour checks owed, in words
def.formula: IF(COUNT(SlotsOpen(startAt, done, endAt)) = 0, "checks up to date", JOIN(EACH(SlotsOpen(startAt, done, endAt), TEXT(item, "h AM") & IF(item < STARTOF(NOW(), "hour"), " check late", " check due")), " · "))

def.label: Late first, then due, then up to date
def.formula: IF(SlotState(startAt, done, endAt) = "late", 0, IF(SlotState(startAt, done, endAt) = "due", 1, 2))

def.label: Hours that closed without a check
def.formula: MAX(0, ROUND(DATEDIFF(STARTOF(startAt, "hour"), IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(COALESCE(endAt, shiftEndAt))), COALESCE(endAt, shiftEndAt) < DATEADD(STARTOF(NOW(), "hour"), -1, "hours")), COALESCE(endAt, shiftEndAt), DATEADD(STARTOF(NOW(), "hour"), -1, "hours")), "hours") + 0.4999, 0) - COUNT(FILTER(COALESCE(done, LIST()), AND(item >= STARTOF(startAt, "hour"), item < IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(COALESCE(endAt, shiftEndAt))), COALESCE(endAt, shiftEndAt) < DATEADD(STARTOF(NOW(), "hour"), -1, "hours")), COALESCE(endAt, shiftEndAt), DATEADD(STARTOF(NOW(), "hour"), -1, "hours"))))))

def.label: Pounds per foot: measured, or nominal
Hours a run ran
def.formula: ROUND(DATEDIFF(startAt, IF(NOT(ISBLANK(endAt)), endAt, IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(shiftEndAt)), shiftEndAt < NOW()), shiftEndAt, NOW())), "hours"), 2)

fields.name: part
fields.label: Part number
fields.hint: e.g. 805, V819. Or tap a profile in the list.

fields.name: isNew
fields.label: This is
fields.formula: IF(ISBLANK(profile.$firstAt), "a new profile", "a change to " & profileId)

warn.message: Not between the lowest and highest

fields.name: wtHigh
fields.label: Highest lbs/ft
fields.ruleText: The highest must be above the lowest

fields.label: Running it now
fields.hint: Off: left out of the needs and the line forms

fields.name: all
fields.label: Every profile (tap one to change it)

fields.name: lineId
fields.label: Line
fields.hint: e.g. Line 4; one strand of a line: Line 3 A. Or tap a line in the list.

fields.name: belongsTo
fields.label: Line it belongs to
fields.hint: Itself; for a strand, its line. Needs are set for this.

fields.name: active
fields.label: Running
fields.hint: Active lines are offered when a shift starts

fields.name: all
fields.label: Every line (tap one to change it)

fields.name: profile
fields.label: Profile
fields.optionLabel: item.$id & " · " & item.lengthIn & " in · " & item.pcsPerRack & " a rack"

fields.name: priority
fields.label: Priority
fields.hint: A line runs its open needs in this order, oldest first within a priority

fields.name: open
fields.label: Open needs: tap the one to change
fields.title: label

fields.name: done
fields.label: Done so far
fields.formula: IF(ISBLANK(pick), "Tap a need above", need.label & " · " & COALESCE(need.made, 0) & " made")

fields.name: racks
fields.label: Racks needed
fields.hint: At or below what is done, the need closes

fields.name: startAt
fields.label: Shift started
fields.ruleText: The start must be in the last 12 hours (or the next hour)

fields.name: caliper
fields.label: Caliper is at the line
fields.ruleText: Find the caliper before you start

fields.name: noNeeds
fields.label: Needs
fields.formula: "No open needs for " & COALESCE(lineRec.line, each) & IF(COUNT(FILTER(NeedChoices(each, COALESCE(lineRec.line, each), EACH(others, item.need)), item.line <> COALESCE(lineRec.line, each))) > 0, ". The needs below are other lines' that nobody is running: pick one to run it here, or Not on the needs list.", ". Pick Not on the needs list and choose the profile.")

fields.name: need
fields.label: Need
fields.optionLabel: IF(item.line = COALESCE(lineRec.line, each), "", item.line & "'s · ") & item.label & " · " & COALESCE(item.made, 0) & " done" & IF(IN(item.$id, NeedsRunningElsewhere(each)), " · running on another line now", "")
fields.hint: The line's next need; other lines' needs nobody is running come last.

fields.name: needFrom
fields.label: Another line's need
fields.formula: "This is " & needRec.line & "'s need: its racks count toward it, marked as made on " & COALESCE(lineRec.line, each) & "."

fields.name: material
fields.label: Material
fields.hint: Filled in from the line's last run of this profile

fields.name: partialInfo
fields.label: A partial rack is waiting
fields.formula: partial.$id & ": " & partial.pieces & " pieces, left by " & partial.line & IF(ISBLANK(partial.location), "", " · " & partial.location)

fields.name: lines
fields.label: Running lines
fields.caption: item.line & " · " & item.part & " " & item.customer & " · " & item.colorName
fields.detail: item.operator & " · " & SlotNote(item.startAt, item.doneSlots, item.shiftEndAt) & " · " & IF(ISBLANK(item.need), COALESCE(item.racks, 0) & " racks", COALESCE(needs[item.need].made, 0) & " of " & needs[item.need].racks & " racks of the need")
fields.tone: IF(SlotState(item.startAt, item.doneSlots, item.shiftEndAt) = "late", "bad", IF(SlotState(item.startAt, item.doneSlots, item.shiftEndAt) = "due", "warn", "good"))
fields.empty: No line is running: start the shift first.

fields.name: slot
fields.label: Hour
fields.ruleText: That hour has closed: a check can be entered until the end of the next hour

warn.message: Off nominal by more than the tolerance
Outside the profile's lowest to highest

fields.name: rackId
fields.label: Rack ID (ERP)
fields.hint: Type or scan the ERP tag

fields.name: partialNote
fields.label: Partial rack
fields.formula: IF(onPartial, "This rack finishes partial rack " & runRec.adoptedPartial & " (" & runRec.adoptedPieces & " pieces already on it)", "")

fields.name: needProgress
fields.label: Need
fields.formula: IF(ISBLANK(runRec.need), "Not on the needs list", needs[runRec.need].label & ": this makes " & (COALESCE(needs[runRec.need].made, 0) + 1) & " of " & needs[runRec.need].racks & IF(runRec.offLine = TRUE, " (" & runRec.needLine & "'s need, made on " & runRec.machine & ")", ""))

fields.name: partialLeft
fields.label: Pieces left on the partial rack
fields.hint: 0 if the last rack was full

fields.name: noNeeds
fields.label: Needs
fields.formula: "No open needs for " & old.machine & IF(COUNT(FILTER(NeedChoices(old.line, old.machine, LIST()), item.line <> old.machine)) > 0, ". The needs below are other lines' that nobody is running: pick one to run it here, or Not on the needs list.", ". Pick Not on the needs list and choose the profile.")

fields.name: need
fields.label: Need
fields.optionLabel: IF(item.line = old.machine, "", item.line & "'s · ") & item.label & " · " & COALESCE(item.made, 0) & " done" & IF(IN(item.$id, NeedsRunningElsewhere(old.line)), " · running on another line now", "")
fields.hint: The line's next need; other lines' needs nobody is running come last.

fields.name: needFrom
fields.label: Another line's need
fields.formula: "This is " & needRec.line & "'s need: its racks count toward it, marked as made on " & old.machine & "."

fields.name: material
fields.label: Material
fields.hint: Filled in from the line's last run of this profile

fields.name: partialInfo
fields.label: A partial rack is waiting
fields.formula: partial.$id & ": " & partial.pieces & " pieces, left by " & partial.line & IF(ISBLANK(partial.location), "", " · " & partial.location)

fields.name: shiftPick
fields.label: Shift
fields.optionLabel: item.operator & " · " & TEXT(item.startAt, "ddd h AM") & " to " & TEXT(item.endAt, "h AM") & " · " & JOIN(item.lines, ", ")

fields.name: scrap
fields.label: Scrap on each line
fields.empty: No runs of this shift are still open

fields.name: caliperOff
fields.label: Caliper left at the line
fields.ruleText: Leave the caliper at the line for the next shift

fields.name: now
fields.label: Running now (tap one for its checks)

fields.name: over
fields.label: Needs with more racks than asked for

fields.name: rackId
fields.label: Rack ID
fields.placeholder: Scan or type the rack ID from the tag

fields.name: found
fields.label: Rack
fields.formula: IF(ISBLANK(rackId), "Scan or type a rack ID", IF(ISBLANK(rack.run), "No rack with that ID", rack.profile & " · " & rack.customer & " · " & rack.pieces & " pcs, made " & TEXT(rack.madeAt, "MMM d h:mm AM/PM") & " on " & rack.line))

fields.name: trace
fields.label: Where it came from
fields.empty: Scan or type a rack ID
fields.title: Rack {$id}

sources.name: runs
sources.formula: FILTER(all, AND(item.date >= TEXT(fromDate, "yyyy-MM-dd"), item.date <= TEXT(toDate, "yyyy-MM-dd"), OR(ISBLANK(lineF), item.line = lineF), OR(ISBLANK(crewF), item.crew = crewF), OR(ISBLANK(profileF), item.profile = profileF)))

sources.name: checks
sources.formula: FILTER(ChecksRecent(), AND(item.slot >= STARTOF(fromDate, "day"), item.slot < DATEADD(STARTOF(toDate, "day"), 1, "days"), OR(ISBLANK(lineF), item.line = lineF), OR(ISBLANK(profileF), item.profile = profileF)))

fields.name: kPct
fields.label: Scrap %
fields.formula: IF(SUM(EACH(runs, item.totalLbs)) > 0, ROUND(SUM(EACH(runs, item.scrapLbs)) / SUM(EACH(runs, item.totalLbs)) * 100, 1), "")

fields.name: bestLine
fields.label: Scrap % by profile and line (lowest marked)
fields.heading: Profile

fields.name: lastRun
fields.label: Last run
fields.formula: IF(ISBLANK(profileF), "Pick a profile above", LAST(SORT(FILTER(all, item.profile = profileF), item.startAt)).date & " on " & LAST(SORT(FILTER(all, item.profile = profileF), item.startAt)).line & " · scrap " & TEXT(LAST(SORT(FILTER(all, item.profile = profileF), item.startAt)).scrapPct, "0.0%"))

fields.name: history
fields.label: Every run of the profile, by day and line
fields.heading: Date
